plugin.description: Time To alarms: lists the alarms coming up next and lets other apps and the assistant set a new alarm or reminder.

actions.name: add_alarm
actions.description: Create an alarm on the watch. Give `time` (HH:MM, 24h) and optionally `rule` (when it repeats: 'daily', 'weekdays', 'weekly=mo.we.fr', 'monthly=15', 'nth=2tu', 'yearly=03-14', a date like '2026-12-25', or 'in 3 days'), `message`, and snooze lengths such as '10m' or '117h'. Or pass a whole CSV `row`.

time.description: Time of day, HH:MM in 24-hour form.

rule.description: When it repeats. Defaults to the next time that clock time comes round, once.

message.description: Text shown when the alarm rings.

snooze_a.description: Snooze length for the top button, e.g. '3m'.

snooze_b.description: Snooze length for the bottom button, e.g. '30m'.

row.description: A complete alarm CSV row, instead of the fields above.

actions.name: create_reminder
actions.description: Create a one-off Time To alarm as a reminder. due_iso is an absolute ISO-8601 instant; without it the reminder rings in one hour.

due_iso.description: Optional absolute due instant in ISO-8601 format.
